title: delphinium peregrinum subsp. verdunense
intro: Delphinium peregrinum subsp. verdunense, commonly known as the Verdun delphinium, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a possible natural remedy for insomnia and sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of Delphinium peregrinum subsp. verdunense include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
